harness_leaderboard.what: Joel Niklaus's Harness Leaderboard (published 2026-11-05, v0.1.1): the same model in 9 coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code 2.1.300, Codex 0.162.1, Pi 1.2.0, OpenCode 1.19.0, Hermes v0.22.1, mini-swe-agent 2.4.6, Kimi Code 2.2.0, Qwen Code 0.25.2, OpenClaw 2026.10.4; plus a claude-code-bare variant), 3 attempts per task, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE v1.1 (111 tasks at datacurve-ai/deep-swe 0b9fabbb, the commit our DeepSWE boards use). Models: GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at low and high effort, Flint (partial).
harness_leaderboard.layout: runs/<run_id>/{run.json,invalid.json,dispatch.json}; runs/<run_id>/deep-swe/trials-<shard>.jsonl = one fact per trial (task, harness, reward, outcome, reused_from); runs/<run_id>/deep-swe/<trial>/artifacts/logs/artifacts/model.patch = the final diff (DeepSWE verifier.collect), verifier/reward.json, agent trajectories. A reused trial's files sit at its source run.
harness_leaderboard.patch_sample: 22 sampled trials: 15 had a nonempty unified diff (19-120 KB, docs and source like DeepSWE patches), 2 empty (failures), 5 copies 404 at the reusing run but present at the source run except one pilot copy.
harness_leaderboard.outcomes: Board outcome = verifier reward >= 1, except answer-key access counts as fail, and infra (sandbox/provider/bridge failures) is excluded; invalid.json rules override. DeepSWE ran offline from 2026-10-23; earlier online trials that looked the answer up were rerun offline.
harness_leaderboard.preview_caveat: From 6,660 of ~7,450 metadata/fact files (download rate-limited); cells above 333 trials include superseded harness versions/adapters that the board's on_board() filter drops. Reproduce the board's exact trial set by running its hlb.scoring.board_facts with its config at the pinned Space commit.
harness_leaderboard.fit: Strong: same DeepSWE tasks and commit as the DeepSWE boards, per-attempt patches and outcomes, ~13k scored trials (about 40 model x effort x harness setups x 111 tasks x 3). Python/TS/JS/Go tasks are measurable with current analyzers; Rust tasks are not. Separate board(s) ("DeepSWE, harness comparison"), never pooled with the Datacurve mini-swe-agent boards. Its rankings would answer "which harness writes less code for the same model".
harness_leaderboard.blockers: None found for numbers: public bucket, Apache-2.0 Space. Raw patches stay external as usual. Unauthenticated access is rate-limited (429); use the HF token. Oracle: the board already fails answer-key access and atif-scans every trajectory; still run our own scan on the online-phase DeepSeek trials.
